test_inv_function: test the inv function by inverting tanh, exp, log, and custom lambda transformations on JAX arrays
test_log_det_scalar: test the log_det_scalar function by computing log-determinant Jacobians for tanh, sigmoid, softplus, and scale transformations
test_is_constant_jacobian: test the is_constant_jacobian function to check if tanh, sigmoid, identity, and linear functions have constant Jacobians
test_inv_jitted_function: test the inv function on JIT-compiled forward functions to verify inversion still works after jax.jit compilation
test_inv_with_arithmetic_ops: test the inv function with arithmetic operations like multiply, divide, add, subtract, and power on scalar inputs
